profile.summary: A private family foundation based in San Francisco that gives grants to support education in the Bay Area. It runs the LIGHT Awards program, which gives teams of California teachers multi-year grants to design their own professional learning projects.

sources.title: Intrepid Philanthropy Foundation - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Same organization: ProPublica shows Intrepid Philanthropy Foundation, San Francisco, EIN 30-0527867, and lightawards.org states LIGHT Awards is a program of it, matching the OUSD grant agreements. The summary says the grants are 'multi-year', which none of the cited pages (about, eligibility) support, and it says 'California teachers' where eligibility is limited to listed Northern California counties; other fields (legalName, ein, orgType, website, email, headquarters) are supported.
